prompt: Create only the REAR view of this up stair flight in true axis-aligned orthographic projection, looking at the opaque back side from behind. It is a stone staircase with side retaining walls; from REAR, do not show any upper tread surfaces or the forward-facing flight. Show the closed rear stone backing / inclined solid stone mass and the backs of the two side parapets, with gray cobbles, mossy olive edges, and consistent blockwork from the source. Preserve the UP/DOWN direction and highest/lowest end positions shown in the source and current accepted views. The rear silhouette may be a solid trapezoidal or stepped backing, but must be a back surface rather than the front stair treads. No perspective, no face-on treads, no scene background. Transparent background, complete centered rear silhouette on a 256x256 view. Inferred orthographic view, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.

reference_inputs.role: source and six views; preserve stair direction/material while replacing only rear

rejection_reason: The generated views still show the upper tread surfaces; they do not depict the opaque rear backing.
